overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair did not reasonably anticipate raising the hiring-freeze topic 48 hours before the June 13 meeting, so it did not have to appear on the notice, though the AG encouraged postponing such topics.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee should have listed a hiring-freeze motion on the June 13 meeting notice because the chair reasonably anticipated it 48 hours ahead.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the chair did not anticipate discussing the issue of the hiring freeze during the June 13 meeting, and we find that the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law with respect to this allegation.
